demos.description: the use of shell companies or other legal entities and arrangements to avoid detection
demos.reasoning: Using shell companies or other legal entities/arrangements to avoid detection is an observable, suspicious behavior that indicates potential attempts to evade regulatory scrutiny and sanctions.

demos.description: conducted or facilitated significant trade with North Korea
demos.reasoning: The description indicates actual facilitation or involvement in significant trade with North Korea, which is an observable high-risk/suspicious activity and commonly associated with sanctions evasion concerns. A compliance officer could detect and flag this based on transaction and trade records.

demos.description: special attention to business relationships and transactions with the DPRK, including DPRK companies, financial institutions, and those acting on their behalf
Any customers that may be involved in the sale, supply, or transfer of the specified items to Russia or to jurisdictions previously identified as posing a high risk of Russian sanctions evasion.

signature.instructions:
Classify whether a candidate description extracted from a regulatory
document is a genuine AML red flag (observable suspicious behavior) or
not (compliance guidance, regulatory instruction, case narrative, etc.).

fields.description: A candidate red flag description extracted from a regulatory document.
True if the description is an observable suspicious behavior that a compliance officer could detect; False if it is compliance guidance, regulatory instruction, case narrative, or background.
